summary: Gifford Pinchot site of a 1924 log cabin and a 1933 L-4 cab on the summit; staffed until 1963, both structures destroyed in 1967; footings photographed in 2019.

facts.design: Log and shake Dark Cabin with roof platform (1924), half a mile northwest of the summit, plus an L-4 cab on the summit (1933)
facts.status_note: Both structures destroyed in 1967; a 2019 photo caption records footings at the site

access.note: Described as a hike from the trailhead at the end of paved FR 9085; no closure mentioned in the sources read

visit.trail_note: About 1.5 miles and 700 feet of climbing from the FR 9085 trailhead, per Willhite

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register and firelookout.com give 5,230 feet for the site; Willhite gives 5,238 feet. The story uses the Register figure.

notes_for_editor: Three sources. The Register and firelookout.com repeat the same text, so the core dates rest on one register entry plus Willhite. Staffing names, the 1937 and 1963 newspaper items and the footings caption come only from Willhite, a hobbyist site; no Forest Service record was found. The brief's access 'unknown' is changed to public, inferred from the described route and the national forest setting; no closure rules were found. Brief fields for status, county, elevation, agency and the 2012 FFLOS registration check out against the Register. A second Willhite page on the nearby Dark Cabin came up in search and was not read.
